duration.text: The Scientific Socialism and International Communist Movement at Hunan Normal University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: 1.HSK level 6. 2.It is required that the applicant should hold a health certificate. 3.It is required that the applicant should obey Chinese law and school rules 4.It is required that the applicant should gain Master’s degree diploma
